notes.title: Demo is out now!
notes.content: [p align="start"][b]Broken Fate demo is out!!![/b][/p][p align="start"]Thank you everyone for the patient wait these past few months! The demo is finally out today!![/p][p align="start"]I really hope you'll enjoy our husband Han and being stuck in the Lotus Pavilion ;)[/p][p align="start"]I can't wait to hear all of your comments and feedback (love and hate alike!)[/p][p align="start"]Join our Discord server and post any discussion about the game in #broken-fate channel. We're so excited to hear discussions from players!! [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/eeCwMbHmXZ"]https://discord.gg/eeCwMbHmXZ[/url][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]If you enjoyed the demo and want to help me expand this game with full acting, more art and content, follow our Kickstarter prelaunch page: [/p][p][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/littlesnek/broken-fate-otome?ref=discovery&"]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/littlesnek/broken-fate-otome?ref=discovery&[/url]...[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Thank you again for your interest. Hope you have fun![/p][p align="start"]-Vi​[/p]
